It was left too long in the damp jungle air. |examine11 = A rotten totem pole, it was left to rot in the jungle. |map = {{Map|2778,2916|2808,2904|2831,2921|2867,2923|2894,2921|2911,2905|mapID=0|mtype=pin}} |id1 = 2945 |id2 = 2946 |id3 = 2948 |id4 = 2950 |id5 = 2952 |id6 = 2954 |id7 = 2947 |id8 = 2949 |id9 = 2951 |id10 = 2953 |id11 = 2955 |leagueRegion = karamja }} The '''Yommi tree''' is a tree grown during [[Legends' Quest]] in the [[Kharazi Jungle]]. It is grown from [[Yommi tree seeds]] and then chopped down and carved to create the [[Yommi totem]]. The tree progresses through 3 growth stages. The tree starts out as a baby, then grows to a sapling, and finally an adult. Once grown, it can be felled, then trimmed, and finally carved into a liftable totem. The tree may also die or become rotten if it is not quickly carved and "lifted-up" (picked-up). Chopping a dead Yommi tree occasionally produces [[magic logs]], making it the only way to obtain magic logs via [[Woodcutting]] without requiring 75 Woodcutting to chop [[Magic tree]]s. ==Woodcutting info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Dead Yommi tree |level = 50 |xp = 0 |tool = [[Rune axe]] or better |time = N/A }} ===Main drops=== When a dead or fully grown Yommi tree is chopped down, up to three rolls at the following drop table are carried out. If at any point the "nothing" segment of the drop table is hit, the reward process is cut short, and no further rolls are given.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1584926611886874624|date=25 October 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107963|archivedate=20 June 2023|quote=(...) You get 3 rolls: 1/10 magic logs 4/10 plain logs 5/10 no logs *and you lose all your remaining rolls*.}} {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Nothing|rolls=3|rarity=5/10|raritynotes= If the nothing drop is hit, no further rolls are made.|skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Logs|quantity=1|rolls=3|rarity=4/10|raritynotes= Up to three rolls can be made in total, provided the nothing drop is successfully dodged.|skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsLineSkill|name=Magic logs|quantity=1|rolls=3|rarity=1/10|raritynotes= |skill=Woodcutting}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Average timber harvest=== The empty spots on the drop table notwithstanding, players can expect to receive regular logs and magic logs in a ratio of 4 to 1 when felling Yommi trees in greater numbers.
